title: 第26章 找刘家二小姐
novel_title: 觉醒阴阳神功：分手后我爽麻了
content_zh:
苏氏集团十三楼。

    项目部主管办公室内。

    陈阳坐在真皮座椅上，手指在手机屏幕上快速滑动，在大学同学群里翻找了许久，终于找到了刘家二小姐刘知柔的微信账号。

    他指尖轻点，发送了好友申请，消息内容简单直接：“嗨，知柔大美女，加个微信，有事找你。”

    他与刘知柔是大学同学没错，但两人在大学里基本没什么互动，平日里甚至很少说话，算得上是最陌生的同学关系。

    不知道她看到申请，会不会同意添加。

    时间一分一秒过去。

    陈阳等了好一会，刘知柔那边始终没有回复，也没有通过他好友申请。

    陈阳挑了挑眉，心里暗道：她估计还没看微信，要是看到了，以同学的情分，应该会加我微信的。

    他在办公室里又坐了片刻，起身准备出去熟悉一下项目部的环境，顺便看看黄金龙那边的情况。

    就在这时，办公室的房门突然被轻轻敲响。

    陈阳有些意外，扬声说：“进来。”

    办公室门缓缓推开，一名身着白色白领制服、搭配黑色丝袜的女生端着一杯咖啡走了进来。

    她身形娇小，面容娇俏，柳叶眉，杏眼含春，嘴唇涂着淡淡的粉色口红，肌肤白皙细腻。

    制服的衣领敞开着，露出深深的事业线。

    那晃动的弧度几乎要把人的魂勾进去。

    黑色丝袜紧紧包裹着纤细的双腿，勾勒出诱人的曲线。

    陈阳的目光下意识被她敞开的衣领吸引，眼神顿了顿，才勉强收回目光。

    女生快步走到陈阳办公桌前，脸上堆起甜美的笑容，声音软糯说：“陈主管，您刚入职，辛苦了，我给您泡了杯咖啡。”

    陈阳正准备伸手去接咖啡，女生的身体却突然莫名抖了一下，手中的咖啡杯没拿稳，咖啡直接泼洒在陈阳的裤子上。

    陈阳吓了一跳，连忙往后缩了缩腿，好在咖啡不是很烫，只是裤子湿了一大片，显得有些狼狈。

    女生姜小媚吓了一跳，连忙放下咖啡杯，连连道歉：“对不起，陈主管，我不是故意的！”
content_en:
Thirteenth floor of Su Group.

In the office of the project department manager.

Chen Yang sat on the leather seat, swiping his fingers quickly on the screen of his phone. After rummaging through the group of college classmates for a long time, he finally found the WeChat account of Liu Zhirou, the second daughter of the Liu family.

He tapped his fingertips and sent a friend request. The content of the message was simple and direct: "Hi, beautiful Zhirou, add me on WeChat and I can see you if I need anything."

It's true that he and Liu Zhirou were classmates in college, but they had little interaction in college and rarely even talked to each other on weekdays. They could be regarded as the most unfamiliar relationship between classmates.

I wonder if she will agree to add it after seeing the application.

Time passed by minute by minute.

Chen Yang waited for a long time, but there was still no reply from Liu Zhirou, nor was his friend application approved.

Chen Yang raised his eyebrows and thought to himself: She probably hasn't looked at WeChat yet. If she had seen it, as a classmate, she would have added me on WeChat.

He sat in the office for a while, then got up and prepared to go out to familiarize himself with the environment of the project department and take a look at the situation at Golden Dragon.

At this moment, there was a gentle knock on the office door.

Chen Yang was a little surprised and said in a loud voice: "Come in."

The office door slowly opened, and a girl wearing a white white-collar uniform and black stockings walked in carrying a cup of coffee.

She is petite in stature, has a pretty face, willow-leaf eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes, lips painted with light pink lipstick, and her skin is fair and delicate.

The collar of the uniform is open, revealing a deep career line.

The swaying arc almost draws people's soul into it.

Black stockings tightly wrapped her slender legs, outlining her seductive curves.

Chen Yang's eyes were subconsciously attracted to her open collar. He paused for a moment before reluctantly looking back.

The girl walked quickly to Chen Yang's desk, put a sweet smile on her face, and said in a soft voice: "Director Chen, you have just joined the job. Thank you for your hard work. I made you a cup of coffee."

Chen Yang was about to reach out to take the coffee, but the girl's body suddenly shook inexplicably. She lost her grip on the coffee cup and spilled the coffee directly on Chen Yang's pants.

Chen Yang was startled and quickly shrank his legs back. Fortunately, the coffee was not very hot, but his pants were wet and he looked a little embarrassed.

The girl Jiang Xiaomei was startled, quickly put down her coffee cup, and apologized repeatedly: "I'm sorry, Director Chen, I didn't mean it!"
title_en: Chapter 26 Looking for the second lady of the Liu family
